comment: The decider providers. A decider answers the typed questions of config/jev.json (route, risk, implementer model, skills, review lenses, tool-call approval) so Claude does not spend tokens and judgement on them. Jev is one provider. The others are OpenAI-compatible chat models asked for strict JSON: free tiers, local models, or Claude Haiku on your plan. bin/craft-decide edits the per-repository override in .claude/craft/deciders.json, so a plugin update never resets your choice. mode first: try 'order' and use the first that answers. mode council: ask every member of 'council' in parallel and average their answers; the result's confidence is the members' average probability of the winning choice, so a split council comes out undecided and Claude decides. The rules floor of bin/craft-jev applies to every provider: a decider can raise a decision, never lower it. Approval of tool calls uses only 'approve_providers'. Keys come from each provider's key_env, or from ~/.config/craft-workflow/<key_file>. Nothing here holds a key. trains_on_data: true or maybe means the provider's free tier may keep or train on prompts; such a provider gets no request text unless you set send_request_text to true for it. Model ids change often: bin/craft-decide discover <provider> lists what a provider serves today.

jev.label: 🦉 Jev
jev.note: TypeSafe's System One decision model through OpenRouter's Decisions API. Calibrated probabilities. About $0.04 per million input tokens. Settings in config/jev.json.

openrouter-free.label: 🆓 OpenRouter free
openrouter-free.note: openrouter/free routes each request to a free model that supports structured output. Free tier limits apply. The upstream provider may log prompts.

groq.label: ⚡ Groq
groq.note: Very fast inference with a free tier. No retention by default, per Groq's policy.

gemini.label: 💎 Gemini
gemini.note: Google AI Studio's free tier through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The free tier may use prompts to improve Google products.

cerebras.label: 🧠 Cerebras
cerebras.note: Very fast inference with a free tier. Check the model list with discover.

mistral.label: 🌬️ Mistral
mistral.note: La Plateforme's free Experiment plan. Check its data terms for your plan.

github.label: 🐙 GitHub Models
github.note: Free, rate-limited models for anyone with a GitHub account. A personal access token with models:read.

cloudflare.label: ☁️ Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.note: A daily free allowance. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID too.

ollama.label: 🦙 Ollama
ollama.note: A model on your own machine. Nothing leaves it. ollama pull qwen3:8b first.

lmstudio.label: 🖥️ LM Studio
lmstudio.note: A model in LM Studio's local server. Set the model id with bin/craft-decide set lmstudio model <id>.

claude.label: ✳️ Claude Haiku
claude.note: claude -p on your own plan or API key, with --safe-mode so no plugin runs inside it. Not free: it spends your usage. The best answers of the list, and the slowest to start (a few seconds).
